During low-tide, however, the water receded into a "marshy run" and made the land part of Virginia, again. This happened daily. There was a court case regarding horse track racing/betting (illegal in D.C., but legal in Va at the time) there that said the racing/betting would have to cease as the judge ruled the land was part of D.C. So then later they dredged the river for fill land to create the parking lots and roads around the Pentagon, finishing construction in 1943 (https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pentagon). By this time, the island is no longer an island at anytime of day-the "marshy run" had been filled in, or so claimed the source, below.
